question.text: A certain reaction A→B follows the given concentration (molarity)-time graph. Which of the following statement is true?

options.text: The reaction is of  second order with respect to A

The rate for this reaction at 40 second will be approximately <math><mn>3.5</mn><mo>×</mo><mn>1</mn><msup><mrow><mn>0</mn></mrow><mrow><mo>–</mo><mn>3</mn></mrow></msup><mi mathvariant="normal">M</mi><msup><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">s</mi></mrow><mrow><mo>–</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></msup></math>

The rate for this reaction at 80 second will be  <math><mn>1.75</mn><mo>×</mo><mn>1</mn><msup><mrow><mn>0</mn></mrow><mrow><mo>-</mo><mn>3</mn></mrow></msup><mi mathvariant="normal">M</mi><mi mathvariant="normal"> </mi><msup><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">s</mi></mrow><mrow><mo>–</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></msup></math>
The [B] will be 0.25 M at 60 second

solution.text:
Time required for concentration to change from 0.4to 0.2is same as the time required for the concentration to change from 0.2to 0.1, it means t 1/2 is independent of initial concentration, i.e. it is a first order reaction.
And from the graph t 1/2 =20 s
∴ K= 0.693 20 s −1
∴Rate=k[A]
At 40second [A]=0.1
∴ rate= 0.693 20
=3.46× 10 −3   Ms −1
=3.5× 10 −3 s −1
